test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

The knight was received / compliments from the king / for his bravery.
solution:
The solution is **T****he knight was received.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** 

 
• The phrase "The knight was received" is in passive voice.
 
• Passive voice suggests that someone received the knight, which is not the intended meaning.
 
• The sentence should use active voice to convey that the knight received something.
 
• In the corrected sentence, "The knight received compliments from the king for his bravery," the direct object is "compliments."
 
• The verb "received" is what the knight did, and "compliments" is what he received, making "compliments" the direct object of the verb "received.
 
• Therefore **option 4 **is the correct option.
